rule_text: "Other hands" is undefined. Of 149 shipped Findings, 14 went the fully autonomous path; the rest went via "other hands," never defined. LOC delta and the 80 self-modifications are not clearly attributable to the agent.

rule_text: Enforcement not uniformly structural. Three gates: kernel unreachability (structural), principal (functional), locked regions (behavioral — the Developer chooses to refuse). No fallback if refusal does not occur.
fix: Ontic-break gate becomes the structural safety claim (a requirement no existing-class arrangement can satisfy is *impossible* for the agent to close). Locked regions remain behavioral. State this plainly and layer it.

rule_text: Safety rests entirely on the principal. One human cannot validate 160k lines they did not write. Traditional software has CI/CD, code review, architecture, modularity for a reason.
fix: Safety is now layered: (a) ontology declared constraints (automatic), (b) ontic-break gate (structural), (c) principal review at ontic breaks (human). Principal is the last layer, not the whole gate.
